file_name: Questionnaire - MM Security - Micron Security Products.pdf

questions.text: Outline any concerns regarding the impact of the Acquisition on competition, including if MM Security and Micron Security Products are close competitors and there are not many alternatives or if one is a major supplier to competitors of the other.
Provide any additional information or comments that you consider relevant to the ACCC’s assessment of the Acquisition.
Provide a brief description of your business or organisation, including any commercial relationships with MM Security and/or Micron Security Products.
Explain how important you consider a physical location is in wholesale supply of electronic security equipment as opposed to an online only offering.
